channel.title: Ground Truth: The Eastern AECO Daily
channel.description: A daily briefing for AECO professionals across the Eastern United States: territory headlines, infrastructure and construction news, a technology pulse, and Graitec and Autodesk updates, hosted by Pippa and Theadore.
channel.itunes:author: Bryan Hennigan
channel.itunes:summary: A daily briefing for AECO professionals across the Eastern United States: territory headlines, infrastructure and construction news, a technology pulse, and Graitec and Autodesk updates, hosted by Pippa and Theadore.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 24, 2026
item.description: New York funds its ports, Ohio approves power built for data centers, Michigan backs a national lab computing center, and fresh projects land in Alabama, North Carolina, and Georgia.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 23, 2026
item.description: Empire AI breaks ground in Buffalo, FeedMore opens its 115 million dollar Hamburg headquarters, Durham locks in the AbbVie campus incentives, Novartis breaks ground in the Triangle, Georgia files the logistics yard for an eight million square foot data center, and Esri and Bentley move GIS and AI into the live design file.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 22, 2026
item.description: Yale opens its 838 million dollar neurosciences center, Cleveland Cliffs commits 1 billion dollars to Middletown Works, Stafford County pushes back on 37 data centers, and Microsoft files a new Virginia campus.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 21, 2026
item.description: The Senate passes sweeping permitting reform, New York clears Propel NY transmission and completes its nuclear master plan, Maryland awards the Key Bridge demolition contract far under estimate, plus Cleveland, Youngstown, Manalapan and Dothan build news and the new Autodesk Content Catalog preview.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 20, 2026
item.description: A billion dollar Jersey City hospital campus, an eight billion dollar Spotsylvania data center approval, the Triboro benefits agreement in Pennsylvania, a Chambers Street station rebuild, and Georgia water funding, plus BIMDeX and the November Forma releases.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 19, 2026
item.description: A second boring machine joins the Hudson Tunnel, North Carolina writes data center power into fifteen year contracts, the Washington airports buy program controls for a twenty billion dollar rebuild, and Georgia breaks ground on its first new state psychiatric hospital in sixty years.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 18, 2026
item.description: Portal North Bridge enters full service retiring the 116-year-old Portal Bridge, Newark Liberty advances its central plant replacement, Astoria breaks ground on a 320 million dollar club and housing project, Effingham approves the Project Camellia site plan, and Virginia's 495 NEXT wins the national Grand Prize.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 17, 2026
item.description: PennDOT names a 1.289 billion dollar low bid for the I-83 South Bridge, BMW opens Plant Woodruff, Spartanburg approves three data center agreements, and new data center and power permits move in North Carolina and Georgia.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 16, 2026
item.description: Dulles opens Concourse E in its 22.5 billion dollar Global Gateway plan, Ohio sets beams on the 700 foot Pratts Fork Creek bridge and weighs the Project Kion plant, Astec sells Roadtec to Komatsu, and Spartanburg heads to final data center votes.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 15, 2026
item.description: Crow Holdings and PGIM break ground on The Apex in New Jersey, Fluidstack builds a billion dollar Virginia campus, BWXT and ABB expand in Tennessee, and safety grants land in South Carolina and Georgia.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 14, 2026
item.description: GlobalFoundries breaks ground on a ten billion dollar Malta fab, Eli Lilly breaks ground on a three point five billion dollar Lehigh Valley plant, Ohio hospitals announce over two billion dollars, and Graitec ships the Ideate Suite with an AI Assistant for Revit.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 13, 2026
item.description: Simon breaks ground on the 100 acre Sagefield in Tennessee, SupplyHouse lands in Georgia, Amazon funds Virginia community college credentials, and Trimble embeds AI inside Connect.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 12, 2026
item.description: Charlotte approves the 2.1 billion dollar CLT Beyond airport program, QTS files its 4 billion dollar Van Wert campus numbers, Cleveland breaks ground on its riverfront amphitheater, and AI agents move inside the BIM model.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 11, 2026
item.description: Oracle breaks ground in Nashville, Lambda names itself for the 33.1 billion dollar Red Clay campus, New York starts 178 million dollars in White Plains housing, and CMS awards 10 billion dollars for rural health.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 10, 2026
item.description: Honda bets 3.38 billion dollars on Ohio, EdgeCore closes 1.5 billion dollars for Virginia data centers, New York funds shovel ready sites, Alabama replaces an 87 year old bridge, and York County breaks ground on fiber.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 9, 2026
item.description: Maryland clears the Chesapeake Bay Crossing for two new spans, Stack tops out its first Stafford data center building, New York funds county infrastructure and tops out a hospital expansion, and Newington approves Seacoast Landing.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 8, 2026
item.description: Connecticut breaks ground on the 1.6 billion dollar TIME-1 rail program, Philadelphia builds its first Center City housing, Raleigh to Richmond rail lands 550 million dollars, and Ohio awards 274 million dollars to finish US 33.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 7, 2026
item.description: New Jersey kicks off the 6.7 billion dollar Newark Bay Bridge replacement and awards the 712 million dollar Hudson Tunnel Surface Alignment, Spartanburg advances two billion dollar data center deals, Alabama funds 73 million dollars of airport work, and Autodesk opens Informed Design for Fusion beta.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 6, 2026
item.description: Dearborn approves the largest school bond in Michigan history at 1.51 billion dollars, Wake and coastal North Carolina fund schools, Rhode Island splits its 600 million dollar ballot, Virginia breaks ground on Hampton Roads Segment 1B, Revolution Wind reaches full power, and Google is confirmed in Lima, Ohio.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 5, 2026
item.description: Lambda names itself for Alabama's 33.1 billion dollar Red Clay campus, Philadelphia rebuilds I-95 northbound, Ohio and Michigan voters fund new schools, Rhode Island backs a Providence school rebirth, and Tennessee breaks ground on two healing projects in Knoxville and Unicoi County.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 4, 2026
item.description: Georgia approves two billion dollar data centers, Vantage buys the Powhatan site in Virginia, WhiteFiber closes in North Carolina, plus battery plants in Connecticut and Ohio and a power readiness lesson for every AECO team.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 3, 2026
item.description: New York awards 249 million dollars for water projects, Rhode Island votes on a record 600 million dollars in bonds, Electra builds an 850 million dollar aircraft plant in Ohio, Tennessee approves a 147 million dollar courthouse renovation, and Google plans a 7 billion dollar West Virginia data center campus.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 2, 2026
item.description: The FRA awards 1.24 billion dollars to eliminate grade crossings with New York taking the largest award, plus a 40 million dollar Rogers Road bridge contract in Wake Forest, Pennsylvania safety and charging awards, and Autodesk named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape for construction management.

item.title: Ground Truth - November 1, 2026
item.description: Enfield rail returns after 40 years, Mon Fayette Expressway opens, Allenwood data center earns approval while a Lansing pitch meets resistance, plus Corman rail, PJM storage, and a new AI design agent test.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 31, 2026
item.description: AEP maps three 765kV lines for Ohio's 10.4 gigawatt Piketon campus and lifts its plan to 100 billion dollars, NVIDIA weighs backing Nscale's West Virginia Anthropic campus, and Jefferson Health breaks ground in Coopersburg.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 30, 2026
item.description: Edwards Vacuum finishes its 319 million dollar New York plant, Jacobs takes on AEP's 37 billion dollar transmission program, FirstEnergy maps 6 gigawatts of West Virginia data center demand, and Newark tops off a 1.8 billion dollar hospital rebuild.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 29, 2026
item.description: Seneca Park Zoo breaks ground in Rochester, Maryland opens a 200 million dollar energy grant competition, Brose Sitech picks South Carolina, Hyundai expands in Montgomery, and Autodesk earns an IDC Leader spot.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 28, 2026
item.description: Salem finishes PFAS treatment, New Haven deepens its harbor, Tennessee clarifies the I-24 concession, Bracco picks Sanford, SteelFab and First Solar grow in South Carolina, and Georgia Transformer breaks ground in Rincon.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 27, 2026
item.description: Central Park breaks ground on flood control, the MTA rolls out modern fare gates, SendCutSend and Blue Bird expand factories, Pennsylvania rewrites fabrication wage rules, and federal manufacturing money lands in Virginia and Georgia.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 26, 2026
item.description: Audi plans a four billion dollar Georgia plant, Pittsburgh starts its one billion dollar Ohio River Tunnel, a closed Ohio paper mill races to become an AI campus, and Sistersville tops out its new hospital.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 25, 2026
item.description: Albany breaks ground twice, Westinghouse bets a billion dollars on nuclear fuel in South Carolina, Mitsubishi Power expands in Savannah, and water treatment projects move in Fayetteville and West Virginia, plus thermal reference kits in Revit and Forma and carbon accounting from the BIM model.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 24, 2026
item.description: MTA launches a 1.9 billion dollar signal overhaul, Niagara Power Transformer breaks ground in Buffalo, Corning invests 585 million dollars in Wilmington, and Dominion clears the local vote for a 3,000 megawatt Virginia plant.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 23, 2026
item.description: New York and Pennsylvania fund 130 water projects, Chattanooga breaks ground on its 282 million dollar courthouse, Hagerstown lands a 355,000 square foot plant, and SOAR AI files its Chillicothe math.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 22, 2026
item.description: Kinder Morgan approves the 3.1 billion dollar Southeast Connector, Intel raises the first truss at New Albany, NCDOT awards the I-85 widening, and Virginia Tech lands a rail resilience center.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 21, 2026 Evening Update
item.description: Pippa and Theadore return with the day's late territory stories: Georgia selects a Ferrovial led group for the 8.9 billion dollar I-285 East Express Lanes, PJM approves an 11.8 billion dollar transmission plan, Effingham County staffs up for the 3.2 gigawatt OpenAI campus, and Colleton County draws a data center exclusion area around the ACE Basin.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 21, 2026
item.description: Pippa and Theadore cover Stack Infrastructure Project Crossroads in Virginia, the Norris Bridge design hearings, the Connecticut River Bridge replacement, Birmingham REDESIGN Alabama, Ohio State Timashev Tower groundbreaking, and the SOAR AI Chillicothe campus update.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 20, 2026
item.description: Pippa and Theadore cover the 2M Constitution Pipeline advance in Pennsylvania and New York, the full .3B CRISI rail round across the East, and Michigan signing 23 BEAD broadband agreements for .447B.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 19, 2026
item.description: Pippa and Theadore cover Pathway Triangle financing in North Carolina, the CleanArc groundbreaking in Virginia, the Savannah Container Terminal permit in Georgia, New York county infrastructure grants, Reading Hospital in Pennsylvania, and the Eastern share of federal truck parking grants.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 18, 2026
item.description: Pippa and Theadore cover Maine rail funding, a Rhode Island trades center, Anduril in Maryland, M.C. Dean in Virginia, Amazon in North Carolina, DC Blox in South Carolina, an Augusta data center filing, Digi Power X in Alabama, and verified Autodesk events.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 17, 2026
item.description: Pippa and Theadore cover the George Washington Bridge South Walk reopening, Ohio and North Carolina rail funding, the UCB campus and Oglethorpe Power loan in Georgia, Virginia and West Virginia transmission, Prysmian in Tennessee, and verified Graitec and Autodesk updates.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 16, 2026
item.description: Pippa and Theadore cover Merck and GSK life sciences investment in Pennsylvania, the Atlantic City Expressway widening in New Jersey, New York thermal energy pilots, Atrium Health and the Port of Wilmington in North Carolina, Medline in Michigan, and verified Autodesk and Graitec updates.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 15, 2026
item.description: Pippa and Theadore cover the PhilaPort expansion in Pennsylvania, Michigan transit awards, Project Red Clay in Alabama, the Nixon data center filing in Georgia, and South Carolina and Virginia groundbreakings, plus Forma and Graitec updates.

item.title: Ground Truth - October 14, 2026
item.description: Maya and Sam launch Ground Truth with Tennessee grid funding, a North Carolina defense expansion, Virginia freight corridor loans, Connecticut bonds, and verified Autodesk and Graitec updates.
